annotations.exact_quote: The proposed ensemble model uses an extreme learning machine (ELM) model as a base classifier
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确所提模型为集成模型，使用ELM作为基分类器，并扩展SAMME提升算法，符合结合多个分类器预测完成分类的集成方法。

annotations.exact_quote: Moreover, the addition of a cost model for weighting the patterns, according to the order of the targets, enables the classifier to tackle ordinal regression problems further.
annotations.reason_zh: 通过成本模型按目标标签顺序加权样本，显式利用并建模目标标签的有序关系，符合标签排序结构建模。
